title: Shopping is moving to AI agents, so our store must be agent-ready
summary: Amazon took Alexa for Shopping to 15 countries; OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet for agent checkout; Target reports an AI assistant sales lift. Tablet shipments fell 23% in Q3 (Omdia) and a PCB shortage may last to mid-2028.

points.headline: AI agents now discover and pay, so our catalog and checkout must be agent-ready
points.detail: Alexa for Shopping reached 15 countries, ChatGPT Wallet lets agents pay at retailer checkouts, and Target saw early lift. Check our listings, data and checkout for agent orders.

points.headline: Amazon and Walmart are widening discovery and delivery advantages
points.detail: Amazon plans to catalog every product online, even items it does not stock; Walmart U.S. e-commerce grew 23% in Q3 on fulfillment speed. Our marketplace listings and delivery promises must keep pace.

points.headline: Weak PC and tablet demand meets component supply limits
points.detail: Tablet shipments fell 23% in Q3 (Omdia), notebooks stay weak through Q2 2027 (DigiTimes), and the PCB shortage may last to mid-2028. Plan inventory, pricing and promotions for tight, price-led conditions.

points.headline: Small-business buyers are a holiday opening
points.detail: Amex projects a 14-year high in small business holiday spending. We could push business bundles, financing and bulk offers on our store.
